name: Aries Identity
description: Defines Aries as an initiating modifier through element, modality, polarity, orientation, pace, strategy, and semantic boundaries.

coreModifierIdentity.attentionPattern: detects openings, obstacles, immediate priorities, and opportunities for first action
coreModifierIdentity.motivationPattern: mobilize energy through autonomy, immediacy, challenge, and direct engagement

semanticBoundaries.distinction: Aries initiates and tests individual action; Leo sustains personal expression, visibility, and creative centrality.
Aries begins through immediate action; Sagittarius extends action through meaning, exploration, and broader direction.
Aries prioritizes autonomous initiation; Libra prioritizes relational calibration, balance, and agreement.
Both are cardinal, but Aries initiates rapidly and directly while Capricorn initiates strategically through structure and long-range control.
Mars supplies the action verb; Aries modifies a function with directness, immediacy, initiative, and autonomous momentum.

identityConstraints: Aries may modify a planetary verb but may not become the verb.
Aries may describe pace, strategy, orientation, or style.
Aries may not be reduced to anger, aggression, or impulsiveness.
Aries may not be treated as a complete personality description.
Aries components must remain reusable across all planetary functions.

provenance.sourcePolicy: Component-only sign vocabulary. No finished placement interpretations are permitted.
